semiconductor_relevance: High — Micro Resist Technology GmbH provides critical materials such as photoresists and polymers essential for lithography processes in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Micro Resist Technology GmbH specializes in the development and production of photoresists and specialized polymers used in nanotechnology, MEMS, and microelectronics. Their products are integral to lithography processes, including UV, DUV, e-beam, and X-ray lithography, and they distribute TOK products in Europe.
capabilities: UV-curable hybrid polymers for micro- and nano-optics

regional_presence.Europe: Micro Resist Technology GmbH distributes TOK products to European customers, enhancing their offerings in the semiconductor value chain.
